column1: TABLE RoommateStatus-main-checklists-v2 - household checklists (one item per checklist, items embedded with per-roommate check state). Every checklist carries a groupId so feeds stay isolated per household. Archived checklists are hidden from the active feed; archivedAt / archivedBy / archivedById are set only while archived. Keyed (groupId HASH, id RANGE): the group is the partition, so reading a household's feed is one Query and no row can be addressed from another household. Supersedes the id-keyed RoommateStatus-main-checklists table, whose rows the 2026-07-21-01 migration copied here.
